entities.summary: Henry VIII declared King of Ireland (1541), the failed Reformation in Ireland, the Desmond Rebellions, Hugh O'Neill's Nine Years' War (1594–1603), the defeat at Kinsale (1601), and the Flight of the Earls (1607).
